notes: Stories created for Mongo Query Size Estimation feature.

change_log.note: Integrate into GPT Reader query flow

stories.title: Define Mongo Query Size Estimation Contract
stories.description: Define a schema and contract for estimating MongoDB query result size including fields for document count, average document size, projected total size, and enforcement thresholds aligned with GPT Reader limits.

stories.title: Implement Query Size Estimation and Guard Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to estimate MongoDB query response size prior to execution using heuristics (doc count × avg size) and enforce guardrails by truncating, limiting, or rejecting queries that exceed defined thresholds.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (enforces response caps and query limits)

stories.title: Integrate Size Estimation into GPT Reader Query Flow
stories.description: Integrate the size estimation and guard logic into the GPT Reader query execution path to ensure all queries are pre-validated before hitting MongoDB and responses comply with system limits.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (Mongo query broker and response handling)

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Query Size Enforcement
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests to validate size estimation accuracy, enforcement of response caps, handling of edge cases (large documents, high cardinality queries), and safe truncation behavior.
